lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I hate to lecture a battle-hardened commander over paperwork,

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: but what is going on with this report?

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: If I didn't know any better, I'd say you just cobbled it together on the elevator ride up here.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I don't care how many successful missions you've been a part of,

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: I won't accept such haphazard reports.
There was no reply from Andersen for a while.

lines.speaker: andersen
lines.text: Sorry, I don't think I heard you. Could you repeat that?
I assure you, this was the best I could do under the circumstances.
